title: Logical Reasoning
description: Develop logical deduction, critical thinking, argument evaluation, causal reasoning and sound decision-making skills.

title: Analytical Reasoning
description: Analyze arrangements, relationships, sequences, conditions and complex information using structured reasoning methods.

title: Quantitative Aptitude
description: Build numerical fluency and mathematical problem-solving skills for competitive examinations and practical situations.

title: Verbal Reasoning
description: Strengthen vocabulary, comprehension, language analysis and the ability to reason accurately using written information.

title: Non-Verbal Reasoning
description: Develop visual, spatial, abstract and pattern-recognition skills using figures, shapes and diagrams.
